evidence.scope: Partial real-phone acceptance; not the complete playback matrix
evidence.user_report: One complete episode without stutters; another episode subsequently watched with diagnostic history and Range tracing enabled
evidence.limitations: Player app variant not independently identified; no continuous Android rebuffer/decoder or multi-hour resource capture; in-memory Range traces unavailable after shutdown

evidence.later_change: Later changes are limited to optional GST, frontend and documentation. Standard Go runtime source is identical; the exact tagged package is checked again after publication.

evidence.native_contract_test: Runs in tagged CI with exported DTOs

publication_policy.policy: Publish the first stable release as Latest after automated gates pass, while explicitly disclosing unfinished field validation.
publication_policy.tagged_gate_required: ts_release.yml rebuilds and verifies the exact tagged source before publication.

remaining_field_validation: Windows boot, sleep and network recovery acceptance
